narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: tsaheylu read as a communication channel. A single glowing neural queue-tendril plugged into a luminous planet-spanning web, a thread of light running away from the connection point into the dark — the image of information crossing a biological cable.
subject: An extreme, reverent close study of the tip of a Na'vi queue meeting the glowing tendrils of a sacred tree: fine pink-and-cyan neural filaments interlacing in mid-air like a fibre-optic connector seating into a port, and from the join a single bright thread of light streaking away into a vast, dim lattice of connections that fills the depth of the frame — one cable in a planet-sized network.
scene: A dark Pandoran night interior near a sacred tree; the foreground dominated by the luminous join of two neural bundles, the background dissolving into an immense faint web of glowing links receding into distance.
camera: A macro, shallow-depth view on the interlacing tendrils, the network behind thrown into soft bokeh so the single bright signal-thread reads against it.
light: Bioluminescent key from the neural join itself — intense cyan and faint magenta at the connection, falling off fast into deep indigo; a single brighter filament of light tracing away from the join.
palette: Void-indigo base, dominant Pandora cyan and a breath of magenta at the living connection, the receding network in dim teal.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence, luminous and atmospheric.
detail_level: Crisp and intricate on the interlacing tendrils and the bright signal-thread; the background network softer, dissolving into haze.
composition: The glowing join low-and-left of centre, the bright thread sweeping across and into the depth, dark negative space upper-right for the plate to breathe.
consistency_notes: Na'vi mostly absent — this is a close study of the connection itself. Cool Pandora palette with from-within bioluminescent key. The establishing 'the bond is a cable carrying information' mood that anchors the whole chapter.
